notes.title: Major Update for BOKKIE is Here! 🎉
notes.notes:
[h1]Hey BOKKIE players![/h1]

[h2]We're excited to roll out a major update for BOKKIE! Here’s a detailed look at what’s new and improved:[/h2]

🌟 Lighting Adjustments: We've fine-tuned the lighting for a better visual experience.

⚙️ Optimized Gameplay: Enjoy smoother gameplay with our latest performance enhancements.

🔇 Removed AI Voice Acting: Simplified the audio by removing AI voice acting.

🔦 Removed Flashlight Item: The flashlight item is gone, thanks to our revamped lighting system.

🎯 Changed Raycast Range: Adjusted the Raycast range for improved accuracy.

👾 Improved Enemy Movements: Enemies now move more realistically, adding to the challenge!

⏳ New Loading Screen: Fresh look for the loading screen to enhance your game start experience.

[h2]🔧 Bug Fixes:[/h2]

Elevator bugs squashed 🚀

Hallway issues resolved 🛠️

Occlusion culling bugs fixed 🧹

[h3]Thank you for your continued support and feedback! Enjoy the updated BOKKIE experience and let us know what you think! 🌟
[/h3]
[h2]Happy gaming!
The BOKKIE Team[/h2]

notes.title: THE ART IN BOKKIE IS NOT AI !!!!
notes.notes:
[h1]Addressing the Art in BOKKIE: Crafted by Passion, Not AI :[/h1]

Hey everyone,

There's been some chatter about the art in BOKKIE, and we want to set the record straight: the beautiful visuals you're experiencing are 100% created by our talented artist, not AI.

We understand why some might think otherwise - the art style is stunning! But every background, character, and detail is lovingly crafted by hand to bring BOKKIE's world to life.

We appreciate your keen eyes, and for those who reached out, thank you! We take pride in our artist's work and want to ensure everyone knows the human touch behind BOKKIE's art.

notes.title: BOKKIE Gets a Bug-Squashing & Brightness Boost! ✨
notes.notes:
Calling all brave detectives!  ️‍♀️ ️‍♀️

We've got a chilling update for BOKKIE that will make exploring the haunted school even spookier (and smoother)! Here's what's new:

Lights Out (But Not Really) The school halls are looking less creepy and more atmospheric thanks to a lighting overhaul. You'll be able to see just enough to keep you on edge!
Copyright Crooks Caught! We've replaced some spooky tunes to avoid any legal nightmares. Now you can focus on the real chills! New soundtrack included!
Bug Squashing Bonanza! We've squashed a bunch of pesky bugs, including some that messed with your movement. Say goodbye to jittery escapes! ➡️
See More, Fear More! We've improved Occlusion Culling, which means the game will run smoother than ever before! ➡️ Get ready for a frightfully fast experience!
We hope this update makes your detective work in BOKKIE even more terrifying! Let us know what you think in the comments below.

Happy haunting!

The BOKKIE Dev Team
